forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: Scroll trace for the EditorKit remount geometry spike ^59ykv6h
+---
+Request from editorkit-7a (2026-11-26). The EK spike `spike/remount-geometry-once` (345b6d5d, base a4bfc1dc, EK card ^59ykv6h) waits for a width before the first remount refresh. It lands only if the AVK 200-row release scroll trace shows a lower main-thread total than the base.
+
+## What
+- [ ] Add `trace-variants/8-remount-once` (EK 345b6d5d) and `trace-variants/9-remount-base` (EK a4bfc1dc), both on the same AVK main, with the same method as variants 1 to 7.
+- [ ] Record case A with `scratchpad/run_ek_traces.sh` (VARIANTS="8 9", HITCHES=1, REPEATS=3) when the machine is quiet.
+- [ ] Send editorkit-7a the main-thread totals, the EditorCompositorMount and LaneCompositorView inclusive time, and the hitches.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] This card has the main-thread total of each variant for each round.
+- [ ] editorkit-7a has the numbers.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Each trace is a windowed run: send start and end lines to testudoapp-9a, editorkit-7a, kanbanviewkit-1c and snapshotviewkit-bc, and run one at a time.
+- [ ] After the runs, `git status` in the main checkout shows no change under `Sources/`.
+
+## Workflow
+- A trace run has no code change. Use `/tdd` for any code change. #perf
\ No newline at end of file
